Medusa: multiple decoding heads

A. Author
Abstract

Extra decoding heads predict several future tokens.

1 Introduction

Large language models decode one token at a time. This makes inference slow (Leviathan et al., 2023).

2 Method

We add K heads on top of the last hidden state.

2.1 Training the heads

L(1)

where k , the head index, runs to 4. The heads are trained with a frozen backbone for one epoch on ShareGPT.

3 Results

Medusa-2 reaches a 2.3x to 3.6x speedup with tree attention.
